claims.evidence: Witness only reports visual identification of a keyboard labeled “PSR-550” and visible wear; no proof of power-on, sound, or full functionality.

risks.risk: Not actually working (no power-on test shown; buttons/display/keys/speakers may be faulty).
risks.proof: One short video clip showing the keyboard powered on, the display lit, a few keys pressed, and sound coming from the built-in speakers (or headphone output) with volume control working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-verified/possibly not working; treat as needing testing/repair risk.

risks.risk: Sound/volume issue (speaker or audio path may be weak or distorted even if it powers on).
risks.proof: Clip playing a few notes and a preset/voice change while showing the volume meter/knob movement and audible output clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for audio problems (as-is with potential speaker/audio fault).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, cables) affecting usability.
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all included items laid out: the exact power adapter model, sustain pedal (if applicable), and any cables.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming key accessories may be missing; buyer may need to source them.

risks.risk: Key condition problems (sticking keys, dead notes, uneven action) not visible in a single photo.
risks.proof: Video showing a full-range key test (left to right) and pressing each key or using the keyboard’s built-in test/demo if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential key faults (worst-case for dead/sticking keys).

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear may correlate with internal issues (dust/scratches/wear marks; casing/display condition).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the display, control panel buttons, and any cracks/loose parts, plus a power-on test to confirm controls respond.
risks.if_unproven: Price considering visible wear and unknown internal condition.

proof_requests: Power-on video: display lit, buttons respond, and keys produce sound (built-in speakers or headphone output).
Audio test clip: play a short melody and show volume control working.
Show included accessories: power adapter and sustain pedal/cables (if any) with clear photos.
Key test video: press across the full keyboard range to confirm no dead/sticking keys.
Close-up photos of the display and control panel buttons (and any cracks/loose parts).
response.reason: The model label “PSR-550” is visible, but the seller’s “working perfectly” claim is not supported by any power-on/sound/key test in the witness report. Without that proof, the price must be based on worst-case functionality risk, so we should request a quick working demonstration first.
